message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine. Large red letters at the top spell "TEMPO." Below, white text reads "RUSUH OLEH SIAPA." Smaller text states "Polisi menengarai peran pensiunan tentara dalam amuk massa 22 Mei. Ada pasokan senjata dari Aceh." Additional headlines at the top read "TERJERAT KORUPSI KAPAL CEPAT" and "BERSIH-BERSIH GADAI SWASTA." A barcode and the date "3-9 JUNI 2019" appear at the bottom left.

The background shows a chaotic night scene. Numerous white sparks and streaks of light, likely from fireworks or flares, fill the air. A large crowd of people is visible in the distance, many holding rectangular banners or signs with "1+2+3=123" written on them. In the foreground, a dark street is littered with debris, including a red traffic signal and what appears to be a discarded red helmet. On the right, a person in a black shirt and grey pants holds a long thin object, possibly a flag pole. Orange and yellow light from fires or explosions illuminates the ground and people. The scene is hazy with smoke and bright flashes.
